name: EPIC 220444120
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 10.9 solar radii and 0.86 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 4,274 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 0.86 solar masses and 10.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,676 K at its surface.
